task_completion.description: Import or define the NACA 0018 airfoil in the QBlade airfoil module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The QBlade airfoil design/import window showing 'NACA 0018' in the airfoil list or name field.

task_completion.description: Generate an XFOIL polar for the airfoil at a Reynolds number of 1,000,000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The polar generation dialog or results table showing 'Re' or 'Reynolds Number' set to 1,000,000 (1e6).

task_completion.description: Extrapolate the generated polar to a full 360-degree range.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 360-degree extrapolation module in QBlade showing a polar curve spanning from -180 to 180 degrees or 0 to 360 degrees.

task_completion.description: Configure the rotor geometry to use the Troposkein (skipping rope) shape with 2 blades.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VAWT rotor design window showing 'Troposkein' selected as the shape type and 'Number of Blades' set to 2.

task_completion.description: Set rotor height to 40m, radius to 20m, chord to 1.0m, and at least 20 elements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The rotor parameter table showing Height=40, Radius=20, Chord=1.0, and 'Elements' or 'Divisions' >= 20.

task_completion.description: Save the project to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog or the QBlade title bar showing the file path /home/ga/Documents/projects/troposkein_rotor.wpa.

integrity.description: The agent used the QBlade graphical user interface rather than just terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with QBlade menus, buttons, and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent actually ran the polar calculation/extrapolation rather than just naming a file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Progress bars or the appearance of generated lift/drag curves in the QBlade plotting area.

integrity.description: The agent built the design from scratch rather than opening an existing completed project.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the manual entry of parameters (40m, 20m, Re=1,000,000) into the GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific QBlade parameters: Airfoil = NACA 0018; Reynolds Number = 1,000,000; Polar Range = 360 degrees; Rotor Type = Troposkein VAWT; Blades = 2; Height = 40m; Radius = 20m; Chord = 1.0m; Elements >= 20. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Documents/projects/troposkein_rotor.wpa. Ensure the VLM confirms the 'Troposkein' shape is selected in the rotor module, as this is distinct from 'H-Rotor' or 'Parabolic' shapes.
